facts.text: The hotel is located on Waikiki Beach, minutes from Leahi (Diamond Head State Monument).
facts.excerpt: Located on Waikiki Beach, the hotel is just minutes from some of Honolulu's top attractions like Leahi (Diamond Head State Monument)

facts.text: Sheraton Waikiki is one of the few Waikiki hotels with true beachfront access, mere steps from the sand.
facts.excerpt: Sheraton Waikiki is one of the few Waikiki hotels with true beachfront access, located mere steps from the sand.

facts.text: The Edge Infinity Pool is the longest oceanfront infinity pool in North America.
facts.excerpt: Edge Infinity Pool, the longest oceanfront infinity pool in North America

facts.text: The Edge Infinity Pool is an adults-only pool for guests 16 years of age and older.
facts.excerpt: Edge Infinity Pool (16 years of age and older)

facts.text: Helumoa Playground is a family pool complex with two freshwater pools and a 70-foot waterslide.
facts.excerpt: Featuring two expansive freshwater swimming pools, this vibrant oasis is designed for nonstop fun. A towering 70-foot waterslide delivers a fast, fun ride

facts.text: Over 80% of the rooms and suites offer ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Over 80% of our hotel rooms and suites in Waikiki Beach offer stunning ocean views.

facts.text: Rooms have a private lanai.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy your morning coffee or watch the evening sunset from your private lanai.

facts.text: The Presidential Suites are on the 29th and 30th floors, each with two bedrooms, two full bathrooms and three separate lanais.
facts.excerpt: Our two Presidential Suites are located on the 29th and 30th floors. Each suite features two bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and a total of three separate lanais

facts.text: The Ohana Suite has two bedrooms and suits larger families, with a capacity of up to 5 people.
facts.excerpt: Ohana Suite includes two bedrooms (one with a king bed, the other with two full beds), perfect for larger families and group vacations with a capacity of up to 5 people.

facts.text: Floating yoga classes are held in the Edge Infinity Pool on anchored boards, with views of Diamond Head.
facts.excerpt: instructors guiding you through sun salutations and core stretches on stable, anchored boards, with stunning views of Diamond Head in the background.

facts.text: Ukulele classes are taught daily at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Ukulele classes are taught daily at Sheraton Waikiki by Ukulele Puapua

facts.text: Lei making classes are offered Monday through Saturday.
facts.excerpt: A variety of lei making classes are available Monday through Saturday

facts.text: Guests can feed the koi in the pond right outside the lobby.
facts.excerpt: Join us as we feed our Nishikigoi, the multi-colored ornamental carp (koi fish) in the pond right outside our lobby.

facts.text: Poppins Day Care offers childcare for children from three months to 12 years.
facts.excerpt: Poppins Day Care offers care for children from three months to 12 years of age

facts.text: Abhasa Spa is at the sister resort The Royal Hawaiian, right next door.
facts.excerpt: Abhasa Spa at our sister resort The Royal Hawaiian, a Luxury Collection Resort, Waikiki is located right next-door to Sheraton Waikiki.

facts.text: RumFire is an open-air beachfront restaurant with views of the ocean, Waikiki Beach and Diamond Head.
facts.excerpt: RumFire offers indoor/outdoor dining paired with panoramic views of the ocean, Waikiki Beach, and Diamond Head.

facts.text: Guests can charge meals at restaurants and bars across the four Waikiki Collection resorts to their room.
facts.excerpt: Guests of Sheraton Waikiki can charge meals from any restaurant or bar across the four Waikiki Collection resorts

facts.text: Room service is not offered.
facts.excerpt: No, room service is not offered at Sheraton Waikiki Beach Resort.

facts.text: A daily resort fee applies.
facts.excerpt: The daily resort fee includes an array of amenities and activities for you to enjoy during your stay.

facts.text: The hotel has LEED Gold certification.
facts.excerpt: with a coveted LEED Gold certification for the hotel.

facts.text: Guests can reserve Luxury Cabanas, Mini Cabanas and Water Lounge Chairs at Helumoa Playground or the Edge Infinity Pool.
facts.excerpt: Guests of the hotel may reserve poolside Luxury Cabanas, Mini Cabanas, and Water Lounge Chairs at either Helumoa Playground or the Edge Infinity Pool during their stay.

facts.text: Surf lessons, stand-up paddleboarding and outrigger canoe rides can be booked with Waikiki Beach Services.
facts.excerpt: Book a lesson, try stand-up paddleboarding, or take an exhilarating outrigger canoe ride with Waikiki Beach Services.

facts.text: Catamaran cruises depart directly from Waikiki Beach for sails along the Oahu coastline.
facts.excerpt: Catamaran cruises depart directly from Waikiki Beach for scenic sails along Oahu's iconic coastline.

facts.text: The hotel tower stands 31 stories tall.
facts.excerpt: The Sheraton Waikiki stands tall at 31 stories
